description: A Reactome pathway group takes part in a biochemical reaction as an input, an output, or both. The edge does not distinguish these roles. Catalysts, regulators and active units do not contribute participation edges.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data sources contributing this relationship; contains Reactome.

common_properties.name: version
common_properties.description: Reactome release number in which the relationship was last seen; indicates current as of that release.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time the relationship was created or last updated.

source_contributions.scope: Biochemical reactions in the Signaling Pathways (R-HSA-162582), Immune System (R-HSA-168256), and Diseases of signal transduction by growth factor receptors and second messengers (R-HSA-5663202) hierarchies, including their descendant pathways, from the human BioPAX export. Degradation and template-reaction events are excluded.
source_contributions.description: Pathway groups represent Reactome complexes, with separate groups for each cellular compartment and modification state, and Complex-typed sets of alternative complexes. A set participates as a single group; participation is not asserted for its individual members. Each group–reaction pair has one participation edge, including when the group occurs on both sides of the reaction. No stoichiometry is recorded.
